items.title: Hasan, Khaled help Kent earn promotion to County Championship's top division
items.summary: Bangladesh pacers Hasan Mahmud and Khaled Ahmed played important roles in Kent’s successful promotion to Division One of the County Championship, with the English county securing a return to the top tier after a one-year absence.

items.title: Bangladesh to face Malaysia in quarterfinals of Asian Games men's cricket event
items.summary: Bangladesh will begin their men's cricket campaign at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games with a quarterfinal against Malaysia on September 29 after the preliminary stage concluded yesterday.

items.title: Asian Games: Malaysia enter quarter-finals after washout, Oman knocked out
items.summary: Quarter-final line-ups: Afghanistan vs India, Hong Kong vs Pakistan, Bangladesh vs Malaysia and Nepal vs Sri Lanka

items.title: Busy calendar leaves NCL short of national team stars
items.summary: The Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) on Friday announced all eight squads for the upcoming National Cricket League (NCL) 2026-27, which is scheduled to begin on October 3.

items.title: Amite experiment comes at Sylhet’s expense
items.summary: Amite is at the centre of Bangladesh’s latest experiment to find a right-handed Test opener. Whether the trial produces a long-term answer remains to be seen, but Sylhet are already paying the price for it.

items.title: Litton: 'Playing Asian Games is a rare occurence'
items.summary: The Bangladesh captain is excited for his first Asiad, and said they aim to add to their gold-medal tally this time
